Case Name: Deploy service and pass health check
Precondition:
1. The registry-center image has been built from source
2. A docker-compose environment is available
Steps:
1. Run docker compose up -d in the registry-center directory to start the service
2. Run curl http://localhost:8080/health to check health see result 1
3. Cleanup: run docker compose down to stop and remove the service
Expected Result:
1. Returns 200 and the response body status is ok
2. After the service stops, the container no longer exists

2. Deletion returns 204
